settings.sourceComposition: 4:3 historical visual grammar inside vertical-safe framing
settings.visualStyle: Grounded late Eastern Han historical reconstruction during the Yellow Turban Rebellion in 184 CE. Human-eye soldier POV, ordinary infantry experience, practical worn clothing and equipment, dusty roads, smoke, mud, fatigue, incomplete visual information and realistic human movement. No wuxia, no fantasy, no superhero generals, no modern action-cinema glamour, no game HUD and no FPS weapon-centering.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. Scene N end state must physically equal Scene N+1 start state. The POV owner is never rendered as an external character. Nearby people behave independently and do not perform for the viewer.

rules: POV does not mean a video-game first-person camera.
Normally no weapon is centered in frame.
Hands appear only when physically needed.
A spear may briefly enter the lower or side edge but must not remain centered.
A shield may block vision when raised.
Most of the image is environment, people, terrain, dust, smoke and incomplete visual information.
Head movement is subtle and linked to body motion rather than artificial handheld shake.
The body turns before the view settles after a rapid change of direction.
The POV can lose sight of action behind other soldiers, shields, walls, dust or smoke.
No floating camera, no gimbal glide, no third-person reveal and no external shot of the POV owner.
forbidden: weapon centered like a game HUD
camera sliding independently from the body

visibleElementsOnlyWhenNatural: belt or armor edge when looking down
povBodyMaster.outfit: plain late Eastern Han common-infantry tunic and trousers in faded earth tones, practical cloth wrappings, simple footwear, restrained protective lamellar or leather elements where appropriate

hanFactionLock.appearance: ordinary men with varied ages, faces, heights and wear levels rather than identical extras
equipment: practical helmets or head protection where role-appropriate
behavior: watch terrain and comrades instead of the viewer
do not pose or form symmetrical hero tableaux

yellowTurbanFactionLock.appearance: mixed rural clothing and improvised equipment with natural variation
yellowTurbanFactionLock.yellowIdentifier: yellow cloth may appear as a headband, wrap or identifying element but must not become a perfectly matching bright-yellow uniform
equipment: simple bows or other plausible improvised weapons

rules: keep weapon and armor silhouettes restrained and practical
avoid dual wielding and spinning weapons
crossbows should be handled as practical military weapons rather than cinematic props

continuityLock.rule: Scene N continuityEndFrame must physically match Scene N+1 continuityStartState.

questions: Can the soldier physically see this from the current eye line?
Can the soldier reach this position naturally from the previous scene?
Would an ordinary infantryman remain here under this level of danger?
Are nearby people acting for survival and duty rather than for the viewer?
Is the enemy visibility appropriately incomplete?
Does the equipment remain plausible for late Eastern Han 184 CE?
Does the action obey terrain, cover and human reaction time?
blockWhen: weapon becomes persistent centered FPS framing
combat becomes a clean hero duel
costume or weapon silhouette becomes fantasy or obviously later-period
scene start does not match previous scene end state

movie.storyTitle: EP01 — Yellow Turban Rebellion, 184 CE: The Rebellion Begins
movie.plotDetails: The viewer experiences the episode through the eyes of an anonymous Han foot soldier. He is not a legendary hero and never appears as an externally visible character. The story focuses on marching, waiting, reacting, taking cover, surviving a short confused clash, helping a comrade and continuing onward.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create a grounded late Eastern Han soldier-eye experience during the Yellow Turban Rebellion of 184 CE. The POV owner must never appear as a visible external character. This is not an FPS game and not a wuxia film. Most frames should show the environment, other soldiers, terrain, dust, smoke and incomplete information rather than a centered weapon. Nearby people ignore the viewer and behave naturally. Combat is brief, confused and survival-driven. No narration, no intelligible dialogue and no music.
movie.storySummary: Before dawn an ordinary Han foot soldier wakes in camp, checks practical field gear and joins a dusty march. Civilians, distant smoke and changing orders gradually reveal danger. The unit moves into fields, reacts to incoming arrows and compresses behind uneven shields. It advances in hesitant short movements rather than a heroic charge. Visibility breaks down near a village, the soldier helps a wounded comrade, observes a nearby crossbow team, catches his breath and then marches onward with the campaign unresolved.
movie.genreDetailPrompt: Historical late Eastern Han human-eye POV. No fantasy, no game-camera grammar and no Romance-of-the-Three-Kingdoms supernatural embellishment.

scenes.title: Before Dawn in Camp
scenes.description: The POV owner wakes before sunrise while nearby infantry prepare.

continuityStartState.bodyState: lying or sitting low beside bedroll
continuityStartState.weaponState: spear and shield nearby, not in hands

scenes.actionDescription: The POV rises slowly from a bedroll and looks across the camp while other soldiers prepare without acknowledging him.
scenes.imageDescription: Human-eye first-person view from beside a rough bedroll in a late Eastern Han field camp before dawn. Nearby ordinary infantry prepare gear. The POV owner's body is not externally visible; at most a sleeve or hand may briefly enter naturally. No centered weapon, no fantasy armor, no cinematic hero composition.
scenes.videoPrompt: Human-eye POV, not a game camera. Rise naturally from low height to standing. Small head movement linked to body motion. Nearby men continue preparing and do not look toward the viewer. No external shot of the POV owner. No narration, no dialogue, no music.
scenes.audioDirection: Breathing, cloth, quiet footsteps, low fire crackle, wooden gear movement and indistinct camp ambience only.

scenes.title: Checking Gear
scenes.description: The POV owner checks practical field gear before formation.

continuityStartState.weaponState: spear and shield beside the body

scenes.actionDescription: Hands briefly tighten a shield strap and inspect the spear shaft. The equipment remains low and off-center rather than displayed to the viewer.
scenes.imageDescription: Human-eye POV looking slightly downward at practical late Eastern Han field gear. Worn cloth sleeve and hand may be visible while checking a shield strap. Spear remains partly outside the frame. Surrounding camp and nearby soldiers remain visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Keep the scene observational and bodily natural. Look down, check a strap, glance back toward nearby soldiers. Do not hold the spear centered like an FPS weapon. No external view of the POV owner.
scenes.audioDirection: Leather, wood, cloth, light armor clatter, footsteps and quiet camp ambience only.

continuityEndFrame.weaponState: shield secured, spear carried low at side

scenes.title: The March Begins
scenes.description: The unit marches along a dusty rural road.

continuityStartState.weaponState: spear carried low at side, shield not raised
continuityStartState.locationState: column leaving camp onto dusty road

scenes.actionDescription: The POV walks within the column. Most of the frame contains backs of other soldiers, road, packs, dust and landscape. The spear is normally out of frame.
scenes.imageDescription: Natural human-eye POV inside a marching Han infantry column on a dusty rural road. Backs, packs, shoulders, carts and road dominate. No centered weapon and no external view of the POV owner.
scenes.videoPrompt: Use natural walking vertical movement and subtle side-to-side head correction. Do not make the camera float or glide. Nearby men walk at slightly different rhythms and do not perform for the viewer.
scenes.audioDirection: Footsteps, carts, cloth, wood, light gear clatter, wind and indistinct group ambience only.

scenes.title: Villagers Watching
scenes.description: The column passes rural civilians and refugees.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV turns the head briefly toward civilians and carts while continuing to walk. Civilians watch the column or tend belongings rather than looking into the viewer.
scenes.imageDescription: Human-eye marching POV passing rural civilians, carts and belongings beside the road. Natural varied clothing. Nobody poses or stares directly into the lens. Infantry movement continues through the foreground and background.
scenes.videoPrompt: Glance sideways while still walking; body direction remains forward. Do not stop for a portrait. Civilians remain occupied with the road, family and belongings.
scenes.audioDirection: Footsteps, cart wheels, wind, cloth and indistinct crowd ambience only.

continuityEndFrame.locationState: road opening toward fields and distant haze

scenes.title: Smoke on the Horizon
scenes.description: The soldier notices distant smoke beyond farmland.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV slows and looks toward a distant smoke column while other soldiers continue shifting around him.
scenes.imageDescription: Human-eye view across farmland toward distant smoke. Soldiers remain only partial foreground context. No dramatic centered reveal and no weapon display.
scenes.videoPrompt: A natural worried glance, not a cinematic push-in. Slight hesitation before the head settles on the distant smoke. Nearby soldiers may cross part of the view.
scenes.audioDirection: Wind, distant unrest, footsteps, gear movement and faint indistinct human sounds only.

scenes.title: Orders at the Crossroads
scenes.description: The unit receives new direction at a crossroads.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV watches an officer or messenger gesture while nearby men adjust position. The viewer is inside the group, not given a clean cinematic view of command staff.
scenes.imageDescription: Human-eye view from inside ordinary infantry at a rural crossroads. Officers are partially obscured by shoulders and gear. Practical banners and dust. No heroic command tableau.
scenes.videoPrompt: Body turns with the group as direction changes. View settles slightly late. Nearby soldiers partially block the officer. No zoom, no perfect composition.
scenes.audioDirection: Boots, gear, horses or carts, wind and indistinct short orders without intelligible dialogue.

continuityEndFrame.weaponState: spear low, shield ready but not raised

scenes.title: Entering the Fields
scenes.description: The infantry leaves the road and spreads through uneven ground.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV steps over uneven ground while nearby soldiers spread imperfectly. The shield edge may enter briefly but does not dominate.
scenes.imageDescription: Human-eye POV moving through uneven farmland with ordinary Han infantry. Natural irregular spacing, low grass, dust and partial shield edges. No centered spear and no symmetrical formation.
scenes.videoPrompt: Uneven footing changes eye height subtly. Men spread at different intervals. Keep environment dominant and prevent FPS weapon framing.
scenes.audioDirection: Footsteps through dirt and vegetation, breathing, shield and cloth movement, distant unrest only.

continuityEndFrame.weaponState: shield beginning to lift, spear low
continuityEndFrame.locationState: low field line with threat not yet clearly visible

scenes.title: First Arrows
scenes.description: A few incoming arrows force the unit to react before anyone clearly understands the enemy position.
scenes.actionDescription: One or two arrows hit dirt or shield surfaces. Nearby men react at different times. The POV lowers instinctively without knowing exactly where the attack came from.
scenes.imageDescription: Human-eye POV during the first few arrow impacts. Dirt jumps near feet and a nearby shield. Men duck unevenly. The enemy remains unseen or only indistinct in the distance. No spectacular arrow storm.
scenes.videoPrompt: Start with ordinary field movement, then a small number of sudden impacts. Reaction is late and uneven. The POV lowers rapidly, and another soldier may partially block the view. No cinematic arrow barrage.
scenes.audioDirection: A few arrow flights, dirt and wood impacts, abrupt foot movement, tense breathing and indistinct yelling only.

continuityEndFrame.weaponState: shield raised, spear kept low and off-center
continuityEndFrame.locationState: same field line with men compressing for cover

scenes.title: Uneven Shield Line
scenes.description: The infantry compresses behind shields without forming a perfect cinematic wall.

continuityStartState.weaponState: shield raised, spear low and off-center

scenes.actionDescription: Men bunch together with shields at different heights. Shoulders, shield rims and bodies obstruct the POV. Some men are still repositioning instead of forming a perfect line.
scenes.imageDescription: Crowded human-eye POV from behind an imperfect infantry shield line. Different shield heights, uneven spacing, shoulders and backs blocking visibility. Dust and pressure. No symmetrical formation.
scenes.videoPrompt: Stay crouched. Nearby men bump and adjust position. View is partially blocked. Fear and limited sight matter more than clear combat spectacle.
scenes.audioDirection: Heavy breathing, shield knocks, boots shifting, distant impacts and muffled human noise only.

continuityEndFrame.visibility: dusty, partial view toward village boundary

scenes.title: Hesitant Advance
scenes.description: The line advances in short uncertain movements instead of a heroic charge.

continuityStartState.locationState: field line facing broken village boundary

scenes.actionDescription: The unit moves forward several short steps, pauses when pressure increases, then moves again. The POV follows because the surrounding group moves, not because he leads a charge.
scenes.imageDescription: Human-eye POV advancing hesitantly toward broken fencing and low village cover. Backs and shields of nearby soldiers dominate. No heroic frontal charge and no centered weapon.
scenes.videoPrompt: Short forward movement, stop, then another short movement. Keep the view crowded and uncertain. No sprinting camera and no triumphant charge choreography.
scenes.audioDirection: Short running steps, shield movement, breathing, distant impacts and indistinct warnings only.

continuityEndFrame.bodyState: low behind broken fence or shallow cover

scenes.title: Close Confusion
scenes.description: Dust, smoke and other bodies make the close fighting difficult to understand.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV turns and ducks through confused movement. Friends, shields and obstacles dominate; only brief partial glimpses of irregular rebels appear. No sustained one-on-one duel occurs.
scenes.imageDescription: Grounded human-eye battlefield confusion at a village edge. Dust, smoke, backs, shields and obstacles obscure most of the view. A rebel with an irregular yellow cloth identifier may appear briefly at the edge, never as a clean centered opponent.
scenes.videoPrompt: No extended sword duel, no spinning, no martial-arts movement and no hero combat. The POV mostly sees backs, shields, dust, partial figures and obstacles. Turn, duck and lose sight naturally.
scenes.audioDirection: Close footsteps, shield impacts, brief weapon contact, breathing, dust and indistinct chaotic voices only.

continuityEndFrame.weaponState: shield close to body, spear not centered
continuityEndFrame.locationState: wounded comrade visible nearby behind cover

scenes.title: Helping a Comrade
scenes.description: The POV helps a wounded companion reach safer cover.

continuityStartState.weaponState: shield close, spear lowered or temporarily released

scenes.actionDescription: The POV reaches under a comrade's arm and helps pull him behind a low wall or cart. Hands appear because of direct physical interaction.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person human-eye view helping a wounded Han comrade behind low cover. Hands and sleeves enter naturally during the lift. Injury remains non-graphic. Environment and other soldiers remain visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Use practical awkward human movement, not a dramatic rescue pose. Hands are visible because they are carrying weight. No third-person cut and no external POV-owner appearance.
scenes.audioDirection: Heavy breathing, cloth, dragging or stumbling steps, wood scrape and distant fighting only.

continuityEndFrame.locationState: safer low cover with nearby crossbow team repositioning

scenes.title: Crossbow Team Nearby
scenes.description: A nearby Han crossbow team fires short practical volleys from cover.

continuityStartState.locationState: same cover with crossbow team nearby

scenes.actionDescription: The POV remains low and watches crossbowmen load and release a short volley. Their weapons stay practical and are not presented toward the viewer.
scenes.imageDescription: Low human-eye view of late Eastern Han crossbowmen working behind cover. Wooden crossbows handled practically. Smoke, low wall and surrounding soldiers remain visible. No weapon showcase pose.
scenes.videoPrompt: Observe from low cover. Crossbowmen reload and fire naturally as a team. No slow motion, no dramatic weapon close-up and no centered POV weapon.
scenes.audioDirection: Crossbow handling and release, breathing, footsteps, distant impacts and smoke ambience only.

continuityEndFrame.bodyState: still low but beginning to stand

scenes.title: Aftermath and Breath
scenes.description: The immediate clash eases and exhausted men regroup.

continuityStartState.locationState: same village edge after short clash

scenes.actionDescription: The POV looks across men catching breath, checking straps, looking for water and scanning the smoke. Nobody celebrates or poses.
scenes.imageDescription: Human-eye aftermath view among exhausted Han infantry near low village cover. Men sit, crouch, drink, inspect gear and stare toward smoke. No victory pose and no heroic composition.
scenes.videoPrompt: Keep movement slow and tired. The POV breathes, looks between nearby men and the smoke, and briefly looks down at dusty ground. Observational rather than dramatic.
scenes.audioDirection: Heavy breathing, soft gear movement, wind, faint distant conflict and occasional footsteps only.

continuityEndFrame.locationState: unit beginning to reform toward departure road

scenes.title: Marching On
scenes.description: The unit reforms and continues onward with the rebellion unresolved.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV walks again inside the tired column. Environment and backs of other soldiers dominate; the road and uncertain horizon remain ahead.
scenes.imageDescription: Natural human-eye marching POV from inside an exhausted Han infantry column leaving the village. Dust, tired backs, road and uncertain horizon dominate. No triumphant ending and no centered weapon.
scenes.videoPrompt: Walk naturally with fatigue. Slight slower head correction and heavier breathing. End unresolved as the column continues. No camera rise, heroic reveal or victory pose.
scenes.audioDirection: Tired footsteps, cloth, wood, light gear clatter, wind and distant unrest only. No music.

generationGate: POV owner is never externally visible.
Han and Yellow Turban visual identities remain distinct but grounded.
Yellow cloth identifiers are irregular, not matching uniforms.
No wuxia motion or fantasy weapon design.
Previous scene end state matches current scene start state.
People ignore the viewer unless accidental eye contact occurs naturally.
Combat remains incomplete, crowded and difficult to read rather than cleanly choreographed.
